verdict.rationale: Name.com publishes an extensive, well-structured public Core API with authenticated endpoints for domains, DNS, transfers, webhooks, pricing, and email forwarding, plus official SDKs (TypeScript, Go, PHP) and a sandbox test environment (docs-1–docs-32). Discoverability for AI agents is reinforced by an llms.txt index and dedicated MCP servers for API access and docs search (probe-1, probe-4, docs-9, docs-19). Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger schema found (probe-3 shows 404s on all candidate paths), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
